name: Britovius

attributes.attribute: a god of the region near Nîmes
compared by the Romans to their god Mars

sources: Monaghan, Patricia. The Encyclopedia of Celtic Mythology and Folklore. Checkmark Books, 2008.
text: Britovius is a Continental Celtic god. People knew little about him. He ruled a region near the city of Nîmes in France. The Romans saw him as similar to their own warrior god Mars.

okr.objective: Describe Britovius, the Continental Celtic god known from Nîmes.
key_results: Britovius was a Continental Celtic god.
His region lay near the city of Nîmes.
The Romans compared him to Mars.
